usage: Original city layout is the edit target; approved concept is style reference only. Three aligned tiles plus two facade continuity edits.

prompts.name: city-aligned-tile-0
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: a registered texture tile for a long 1183x3549 transparent city background in a mobile game. Image 1 is the EXACT edit-target layout tile; Image 2 is STYLE ONLY, not a layout guide.
Primary request: Repaint Image 1 in the approved miniature architecture style while retaining every existing building region, vertical boundary, width, stepped silhouette, transparent gap, occlusion and original wide horizontal ledge at EXACTLY the input coordinates. UPPER THIRD: preserve every skyline silhouette, antenna and stepped rooftop exactly; the visible buildings must continue down through the bottom edge.
Visual direction: this is DISTANT BACKGROUND, deliberately quieter than the playable ivory/coral tower. Muted cool blue-gray glass, warm-gray stone, pale ivory trims, soft sage-gray accents, airy atmospheric haze, low-to-medium contrast and low saturation, soft volumetric side shading. Add fine, orderly facade window grids and restrained ceramic ledge detail inside the EXISTING colored regions. Keep original building outlines and inter-building alignment exactly; buildings remain simple straight continuous towers. Blue input regions remain distinguishable as subdued cool blue-gray glass; gray regions become pale warm-gray/ivory stone. Do NOT add any new building, foreground tower, balcony module, lamp, plant, tree, fence, cloud, residents, crane or UI. No bright coral/orange accents in this background; reserve them for the playable foreground.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: This is one seamlessly registered tile, not a newly composed city scene. Top and bottom cut edges stay straight and match the input continuation; no vignette or borders. Preserve transparent holes and the building shapes. The input's broad value changes and ledge locations stay readable but subtle. Opaque building surfaces; genuine alpha in original gaps. Output square at least 1280x1280, preferably2048x2048, with the exact input composition. No text, logos or watermark.

prompts.name: city-seam-0
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: a wide horizontal continuity-repair texture patch for an existing tall city background. The input is the exact edit target, a 1183x400 crop of the background.
Primary request: Remove ONLY the obvious horizontal join running across the middle of the input. Repair the architecture so each individual building facade, glass panel grid, stone pier, color, lighting and texture continues naturally from the upper half into the lower half. Keep every building at its exact same horizontal location and width; retain all vertical silhouette edges, original transparent gaps and overlapping building layers. Smooth away changes of window scale/color at the center; connect upper and lower wall grids and all thin vertical trims cleanly. Existing horizontal ledges may remain where they belong to individual buildings, but there must be no single cross-image horizontal cut or straight join line. Do NOT add or remove a building, rooftop, horizon, floor, cloud, foreground object or decoration.
Preserve the uppermost and lowermost 40px and left/right borders to match this exact input seamlessly. Same subdued ivory stone, blue-gray glass, miniature architectural style, soft distant shading, no extra saturation or contrast. Genuine alpha transparency remains in existing gaps; building pixels stay opaque. Entire patch is one wide image in the same roughly3:1 aspect, at least1536px wide so it can be downsampled to1183x400. No framing, text, logo or watermark.
